Selected publications

Research articles and reviews, with short summaries and links to the original publication records.

Download selected citations (CSV)
  1. 2021

    Thermal imaging · Review

    Thermal Infrared Face Recognition

    A review of thermal infrared approaches to face recognition, including temperature patterns, facial vasculature and computational methods. It surveys earlier work on imaging characteristics and the use of machine learning in this field.

    Paper summaryDOI: 10.7759/cureus.13736
  2. 2020

    Decision theory · Review

    Personality and Genetics Correlations to Risk-Taking Using Quantum Decision Theory in Balloon Analogue Risk Tasks

    A review connecting quantum decision theory with research on risk-taking in the Balloon Analogue Risk Task. It considers reported personality and genetic associations, and proposes ways to incorporate these factors into probabilistic decision models.

    Paper summaryDOI: 10.7759/cureus.9923
  3. 2019

    Image-guided radiotherapy · Device concept

    Concept for a Fan-beam Computed Tomography Image-guided Radiotherapy Device

    A proposed radiotherapy device combines a 6 MV linear accelerator with fan-beam CT guidance. The paper describes the Simple XRT concept and considers equipment cost and shielding requirements in the design of a treatment system.

    Paper summaryDOI: 10.7759/cureus.4882
  4. 2018

    AI & radiation oncology · Review

    Artificial Intelligence in Medicine and Radiation Oncology

    A review of potential applications of artificial intelligence in radiation oncology, particularly workflow efficiency and error reduction. It discusses automated data transfer and decision support as ways to improve clinical operations.

    Paper summaryDOI: 10.7759/cureus.2475
